AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Escudo is the user's car insurer. Functions let an agent read the user's policy and coverage, report a car accident (opens a claim and assesses damage from photos) and check a claim's status. Operational patterns: - For a crash, call 'reportAccident' with the user's description and photos, then 'getClaimStatus' with the returned claimId. - Call 'getCoverage' with an incidentType to check whether an incident is covered before promising anything. Constraints: - Accepting the deductible, choosing a repair shop and signing the claim are NOT available here: they always require the user's approval in the Escudo app.
